tasks.title: How many raw items ArduPilot will show
tasks.solution: Every MissionItem with a speed becomes two items: NAV_WAYPOINT (16) and DO_CHANGE_SPEED (178). There are n + 1 plan items (with the placeholder), so 2·(n + 1) items; the placeholder went into seq 0 and was replaced by home, so the item count does not change. In the module's run: 3 waypoints → 8 items.

tasks.solution: Δ = d·10⁻⁷ degrees; meters = Δ·111 320. In the module's run, d = 3593 → 40.0 m, d = 7186 → 80.0 m, d = 10 780 → 120.0 m, matching the specified offsets.

tasks.title: How far a slow subscription consumer falls behind
tasks.solution: By second 60 the handler has processed 60000/t samples (t in ms). Sample number N arrived at second N/f, so the current one was taken at second 60000/(f·t), and its age is 60 − 60000/(f·t) s. If f·t ≤ 1000 (processing is faster than arrival), the queue does not build up and the age is ≈ 0. Examples: 50 Hz × 30 ms → 60 − 40 = 20 s; 20 Hz × 100 ms → 60 − 30 = 30 s. The cure: a one-off read of the latest value, or draining the queue.
